annotations.title: Read or replace Studio source or a Mobile draft

description: Reads or replaces one project this account owns. action get reads a Cloud page, Studio source, or a Mobile Expo draft. action save replaces Studio source or a Mobile draft, does not publish a site, and does not start an EAS build. Use project for one existing row. Use create_project to create it, list_projects to find the id, deploy to publish Cloud HTML, database for Data tables and records, and export for a ZIP or JSON download. A Mobile save requires expectedUpdatedAt from the last get or save. Cloud, Data, and Code cannot be saved here.

action.description: get reads. save replaces Studio source or a Mobile draft. save does not publish Cloud HTML.

draft.description: Mobile save only. Full Mobile builder draft, version 1. The save replaces the stored draft.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Required for a Mobile save. Use updated_at from the last get or save. A mismatch returns 409 and does not write.

files.description: Studio save only. Source map. index.html is required. Paths end in html, css, js, json, md, or svg.

html.description: Studio save only. Complete HTML preview document. Cloud pages are published with deploy, not saved here.

name.description: Optional new display name on save. Studio: 1 to 100 characters. Mobile uses this or draft.appName.

product.description: cloud, studio, or mobile can be read. studio or mobile can be saved. data is refused and belongs on database. code is refused.

projectId.description: UUID of the Cloud site, Studio project, or Mobile project this account owns.

prompt.description: Studio save only. Replaces the stored prompt. Up to 4,000 characters.
